tool_args.rationale: The supply-bullwhip bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon. Varying the sink gradient is needed to identify its inhibition and distinguish competing branch mechanisms before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have s_grad=1, so the sink-inhibition parameter is not identifiable, and the branch alternatives remain ambiguous.
The bridge and flux-conservation signatures favor the static siphon mechanism over a coupled-memory ODE; the branch probe is cheaper and directly tests the missing gradient dependence.
It does not address the identified ambiguity.
